tuberculosis--noun.def: A serious infectious disease of the lungs.

tolerant--adj.def: Willing to accept ideas and behaviour you dislike.

exceed--verb.def: To be more than a limit or an amount.
exceed--verb.ex: Do not exceed the speed limit.

flutter--noun.def: A quick light movement of wings or cloth.
flutter--noun.ex: There was a flutter of wings.

foresee--verb.def: To know what will happen before it does.

hospice--noun.def: A place caring for people who are very ill.

independently--adv.def: Without help or control from others.

deduction--noun.def: A conclusion reached by reasoning, or an amount taken off.

dependable--adj.def: Able to be trusted to do what is needed.
dependable--adj.ex: The old van proved surprisingly dependable.
dependable--adj.exTr: Eski minibüs şaşırtıcı biçimde güvenilir çıktı.

pebble--noun.def: A small smooth stone found on a beach.
pebble--noun.ex: She picked up a flat pebble.

stylist--noun.def: A person who advises on hair or clothes.

puzzled--adj.ex: She gave me a puzzled look.

pedestrian--noun.def: A person walking rather than driving.

relativity--noun.def: The scientific theory about space, time and gravity.

distortion--noun.def: A change that makes something wrong or unclear.
distortion--noun.ex: The report is a distortion of facts.

bureaucracy--noun.def: Official rules and procedures that slow things down.

reverence--noun.ex: They spoke of him with reverence.
reverence--noun.exTr: Ondan derin bir saygıyla söz ettiler.

cannonball--noun.def: A large iron ball fired from an old gun.
cannonball--noun.ex: A cannonball is stuck in the wall.

overtake--verb.def: To pass a slower vehicle or person.
overtake--verb.ex: Do not overtake on the bend.

liner--noun.def: A large ship that carries passengers.

articulate--verb.def: To express an idea clearly in words.

disapprove--verb.def: To think that something is wrong or bad.
disapprove--verb.ex: Her parents disapprove of the plan.

bestow--verb.def: To give something as an honour, in formal English.
bestow--verb.ex: The king bestowed a title on her.

width--noun.def: The distance from one side of something to the other.
width--noun.ex: Measure the width of the door.

sanitation--noun.def: The systems that keep water and waste clean.

endorse--verb.def: To say publicly that you support someone or something.

prompt--adj.ex: Thank you for your prompt reply.

prompt--noun.def: A word or a sign that reminds you what to say.

prompt--verb.def: To cause something to happen, or to remind someone.

safeguard--verb.def: To protect something from harm or loss.

birthplace--noun.def: The place where someone was born.

timeless--adj.def: Not affected by changes in fashion.

newscaster--noun.def: A person who reads the news on television.

obituary--noun.def: An article about someone who has just died.
obituary--noun.ex: The paper printed a long obituary.
obituary--noun.exTr: Gazete uzun bir ölüm ilanı yayımladı.

invoke--verb.def: To use a law or a right to support your case.
invoke--verb.ex: She invoked her right to silence.

hijack--noun.def: The act of taking control of a vehicle by force.

hijack--verb.def: To take control of a plane or a lorry by force.

impartial--adj.def: Not favouring one side over another.

tabloid--adj.def: Relating to small popular newspapers full of gossip.
tabloid--adj.ex: The tabloid press ran the story.

tabloid--noun.def: A small popular newspaper with short sensational stories.
tabloid--noun.ex: He reads a tabloid every morning.
tabloid--noun.exTr: Her sabah bir bulvar gazetesi okuyor.

mimic--noun.def: A person who is good at copying others.

thoughtless--adj.def: Not thinking about how others feel.

reinforce--verb.def: To make something stronger or more certain.

soundtrack--noun.def: The music recorded for a film.

advancement--noun.def: Progress in a career or in knowledge.

ozone--noun.def: A gas high in the air that blocks harmful sunlight.

compression--noun.def: The act of pressing something into a smaller space.

demolish--verb.def: To pull down a building completely.

generously--adv.def: In a way that gives freely.
generously--adv.ex: He gave generously to the fund.

yawn--noun.def: The act of opening your mouth wide when tired.

yawn--verb.def: To open your mouth wide because you are tired.

prevention--noun.def: The act of stopping something from happening.

repression--noun.def: The strict control of people by force.

coarse--adj.def: Rough in texture, or rude in manner.
coarse--adj.ex: Use coarse salt for the fish.

knowingly--adv.def: Doing something although you know it is wrong.
knowingly--adv.ex: He knowingly signed a false form.
knowingly--adv.exTr: Bile bile sahte bir form imzaladı.

affordable--adj.def: Cheap enough for most people to pay.
affordable--adj.exTr: Kasabanın uygun fiyatlı konuta ihtiyacı var.

disorderly--adj.def: Untidy, or behaving in an uncontrolled way.

unattractive--adj.def: Not pleasant to look at or to consider.

optimist--noun.def: A person who expects good things to happen.
optimist--noun.ex: He has always been an optimist.

barbershop--noun.def: A shop where men have their hair cut.

readily--adv.def: Quickly and willingly, or easily obtained.

confine--verb.def: To keep someone in a place, or to limit something.

exaggeration--noun.def: A statement that makes something seem bigger than it is.

overhear--verb.def: To hear what others say without meaning to.
overhear--verb.ex: I overheard part of the call.
overhear--verb.exTr: Görüşmenin bir kısmına kulak misafiri oldum.

germ--noun.def: A very small living thing that causes illness.

compute--verb.def: To calculate an amount, especially with a machine.

stereotype--noun.def: A fixed and unfair idea about a group of people.

thereafter--adv.def: After that time, in formal English.

supplement--noun.def: Something added to improve or complete a thing.

misleading--adj.def: Giving a wrong idea on purpose or by accident.
